examples.title: Example 1: Setting the Text Style
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to apply different text styles and configure click events for the Span component.

examples.title: Example 2: Setting the Text Shadow
examples.description: In API version 11 and later versions, the textShadow attribute is used to set the text shadow.

examples.title: Example 3: Setting the Background Style
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set the background style for text using the textBackgroundStyle attribute, available since API version 11.

examples.title: Example 4: Setting the Text Baseline Offset
examples.description: In API version 12 and later versions, this example demonstrates how to set different baseline offsets for text through the baselineOffset attribute.
